justification: Paid conveyancing PDF flood row, summary and CDC flood input. Not Critical: only removes over-claims (PMF/non-flood rows) and a false 'no' for unheld councils. Not Minor: printed report wording changes.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if the CDC flood input ignores the supplied answer, or a failed flood lookup in the report becomes a no.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Producer measured on 310 saved points (PR #1539); spatial_overlays_coverage lists 12 of 72 flood councils (live query 2026-10-28).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: New tests assert behaviour absent before: the CDC function had no flood_status input.

pre_impl.existing_data: generate_pdf receives lat/lng; unique_by_type keyed any 'flood' row as a hit.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Coverage table understated flood (12 vs 72 councils).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One helper calling the existing producer; no new flood logic.
pre_impl.external_source_error: DB failure gives value None: row omitted, summary does not name flood.

functions.name: get_flood_planning_status
functions.input: latitude and longitude of the property
functions.output: dict with value True, False or None and a reason
functions.if_none: Any failure returns value None with a reason.
functions.edge_cases: services/ not on path in CLI context
functions.failure_mode: Row omitted; never a printed no

functions.name: build_cdc_inputs
functions.what: Optional flood_status overrides the raw overlay reading.
functions.input: report-shaped data plus optional flood answer
functions.output: CdcScreenInputs with flood_prone True, False or None
functions.if_none: No flood_status keeps the old overlay rule unchanged.

break_it.scenario: Address only inside a PMF extreme flood line
break_it.what_happens: Report does not count flood and CDC reads not flood prone

break_it.scenario: Council whose flood map we do not hold
break_it.what_happens: Flood row omitted and the summary does not name flood

break_it.scenario: Database down during the PDF build
break_it.what_happens: Flood answer is not known, never a clean no
